_tableColumns: Header-name patterns (case-insensitive regex) that let the built-in reader pull stops straight out of a structured table's columns — the reliable path for table-formatted quotations, where a whole stop (company + address + notes) sits in one long row the line-scanner would skip. A table is treated as a stop list only if a header matches addressColumnPattern; the row's kind (pickup vs delivery) comes from the typeColumn cell, else from the address column's own header (e.g. 'Collection Address' vs 'Delivery Address'), classified against pickupLabels/dropLabels — no new hardcoded words.
_outboundHubColumnPattern: Header of the destination/outbound hub column in a hub-transfer table. Its cell postcode aims the trunk's destination hub when a milk-round sheet lists only collection stops (no delivery addresses to be nearest to).
_collectionSignals: Document-level phrases that mark a PDF as a COLLECTION/pickup round (not a delivery). Any one hit flips the quote to collection mode. Kept as strong multi-word phrases so a single stray 'collection' label on a delivery sheet never trips it.
